title: Complete the full-app audit with route-family and Frequency visual evidence, beyond structural checks
detail:
Audit main 4410c0944 in an isolated checkout; do not disturb concurrent work. Physical inventory: 535 tracked page/route entrypoints grouped into 120 audit buckets (groupings are not resolved public URLs); includes 112 API handlers, 107 admin and 62 main Space entrypoints. Metadata routes and the separate mobile app require additional inventory, so this count is not a whole-repo completeness claim. Initial 26 source checks passed and live parity proved all 855 migrations match version/name; two out-of-band backups are separately tracked by SEC-002. P2 email DB opportunities are PERF-002. Cache verification timeouts repaired under HYG-173; 404 local tests across 27 suites pass for SEO/AI-search, site caching, commerce, CRM privacy/consent and recovery, plus 79 earlier timer/token tests. Most data behavior is mocked, not production-proven. Continue per-area source tracing and meaningful behavioral tests, Frequency light/dark/mobile rendering and accessibility, anonymous cache/latency proof, build artifact budgets, orphan-module reachability, all create/edit/navigation flows and mobile integration where present. Existing owner-dependent payment/backup/search-provider proof stays on its own canonical rows. Publication and production mutations still need explicit human authorization in this chat.

2026-10-23 expanded audit: current main remains 4410c0944, concurrent Home/pricing PR is now #3881 (earlier #3880 closed); no publication or merge. Full web census exercised 1,985 files / 24,018 tests (24,001 passed, 15 failures, 2 pending) while repairs evolved. Preview resolver, collision timeout, local load harness and profile-year failures have green focused reruns; backlog suite timing/cost is not yet green and its stale visual provenance row LIVE-312 is reopened rather than forged. Related event conversion repair passes 1,999 tests across 134 suites. Native nine pure tests, lint and typecheck pass after task-owned install. Isolated real Frequency compile passes, as do five local artifact gates (7.49GB function traces, 1,124KB member shell, 328KB front door); cache warn-only estimate is 0.55GB and is not an enforcing verdict. Latest 27 source checks have 26 pass plus the deliberate missing-ledger skip; fresh read-only parity separately proves all 855 version/name pairs still exact. Public anonymous browser coverage now includes 26 distinct URLs at 320/1280; six expanded axe injections were interrupted by the separately repaired Sentry CSP failure, not counted as a11y passes. Actual local CSS/source-equivalent DOM preview across the 19 added URLs has 76/76 light/dark/width cases with zero axe A/AA violations and no overflow, in addition to the earlier eight light and eight dark cases. Timer has sixteen real SSR fixture previews, not a hydrated route proof. All four live discovery endpoints return 200 with correct content types; sitemap XML parses with 554 URLs. No indexing/ranking/AI-citation acceptance is inferred. Per-entry evidence matrix names all 535 physical routes and explicitly leaves authenticated browser journeys unproved. Production backup permissions SEC-002, SQL rollout SCAN-1037/PERF-002, provider/payment/storage proofs, native hardware, genuine visual capture and remaining product phases are not counted done.

2026-10-23 continuation: integrated current main 64bcc26ca (#3882) locally without touching the concurrent checkout. Sixteen stale source/capture-metadata checks are restored with regression controls; a frozen full guard on 0bc6bc419 exits zero with 1740 agreements and only LIVE-884 explicitly indeterminate (known actual nonpublic product fixture missing). Whole-tree typing and a fresh Frequency compile plus all six artifact gates pass on 58ab49fe9, which contains every app repair and Home integration; subsequent commits change audit probes/ledger only. Two-design orphan review retires the superseded map resolver and obsolete font loader/faces while retaining deliberate test/tool foundations and the inactive design font. Twenty-seven repeatable source checks yield 26 passes and one migration partial; supplemental metadata parity matches all 855 version/name pairs. Fresh backup grant metadata and exact proposed SQL disposable tests do not close SEC-002: production approval remains absent. Authenticated visual/route, native hardware, private-cache and controlled real money/provider acceptance remain unproved; canonical unfinished product phases are still open, not relabeled approvals. No publishing, deployment or production mutation.

2026-10-24 local continuation: main64bcc26ca and concurrent copy PR3883 revalidated unchanged. The 535-entry route set is unchanged. SCAN-1047 repairs audience row-cap truncation with 58 focused tests and six regression controls (two refreshed combined-run timeouts retained; unchanged isolated retries fail their intended assertions). Whole-tree typing first caught a nullable display-name mismatch, corrected in878289f3f with actual-action email recorder cases; typing now passes and a local compile/six gates remain active on878. SCAN-1048 repairs shared PDF parser cleanup with actual-function synthetic cases, three consequence controls and two installed-real-parser cases. The earlier58ab build does not cover these later app changes, and the running878 build does not cover the PDF delta. Full current-head guard/build integration is not inferred from prior results. All publication/production boundaries and remaining owner/runtime/product gaps remain open.

verify.evidence: Open: inventory and structural checks are complete for the stated snapshot, but no complete route-family runtime/visual evidence exists yet. Close only when each inventoried area has evidence for its user journeys and failure paths, Frequency tokens/visuals and accessibility, security ownership boundaries, public SEO/AI visibility, performance and orphan wiring; clearly identify blocked or owner-dependent proof rather than counting it as passed.
